definitions.explanation: Temperature below zero degrees, typically Celsius. Used when stating temperatures below the freezing point.

examples.japanese: {今朝|けさ}は{零下|れいか}5{度|ど}だった。
examples.english: It was minus 5 degrees this morning.

examples.japanese: {気温|きおん}が{零下|れいか}になると{水道管|すいどうかん}が{凍|こお}る。
examples.english: When the temperature drops below zero, water pipes freeze.

examples.japanese: {北海道|ほっかいどう}では{冬|ふゆ}に{零下|れいか}20{度|ど}を{下回|したまわ}ることもある。
examples.english: In Hokkaido, temperatures can drop below minus 20 degrees in winter.

notes:
USAGE:
Used before a number to indicate a temperature below zero: {零下|れいか}10{度|ど} (minus 10 degrees). マイナス is also commonly used in spoken Japanese for the same purpose.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {零下|れいか}～{度|ど} (minus ~ degrees)
- {零下|れいか}になる (to drop below zero)
- {零下|れいか}を{記録|きろく}する (to record sub-zero temperatures)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- マイナス: minus — loanword, commonly used in spoken Japanese
- {氷点下|ひょうてんか}: below freezing point — more formal, specifically refers to below 0°C
